items.title: I turned Naval Ravikant into an AI agent
items.raw_excerpt: I cloned Naval (@naval), fully powered by the Nia API (trynia.ai). The agent has access to all of his indexed archive of learnings and essays from his website. I built this because I was tired of manually searching through every essay to find the precise passages and real context behind his thinking. This agent can search, cite, and retrieve Naval’s actual words directly from the source. It is free and open source. You can check the code here: https://github.com/nozomio-labs/naval-ai
